key.name: default-output-dir
key.description: Default directory path where watermarked PDFs will be saved.

key.name: overwrite-behavior
key.description: Whether to overwrite original files by default without asking for a new file name.

key.name: remember-last-dir
key.description: Whether to remember the last used output directory across application restarts.

key.name: preview-quality
key.description: Quality level for live PDF preview rendering ('low', 'medium', 'high').

key.name: window-width
key.description: Saved main window width in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Saved main window height in pixels.

key.name: is-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized on last exit.
